physics: Same N8 dual (.6,.6) centered-boundary network, causal controls, all physical laws and objectives. Newton is the pinned implementation. Halley re-expresses the regenerative QVI by the dimensionless Lambert-W equation, four Halley steps with a finite-domain assertion and explicit first-order VJP. Tangent replaces QVI with its affine first-order expansion at fixed nominal law, matched at value and both local drift/cost slopes, no extra trainable parameters. Ordinary learned has the same initial function and adds 2 bounded learned slope gains per neuron. All arms retain diffusion transport, two forces, message geometry and receiver-only readout.
data: Same 8-frame slices, station/year and future-day splits and source checksums as first matrix. Additional preregistered comparison on the same testing populations. Plan frozen before primary held-out evaluation.
training: 48 Adam updates, lr .003, batch 12, CE, global norm clip 2, matched train rows. Dev at 0,12,24,36,48, select first lowest Brier. Fresh OS process per slot, deterministic CPU single-thread, four-arm order rotated across task/seed. All 24 checkpoints sealed before evaluation. Report complete data prep, training, reload/eval and Python startup; day/site paired estimates.
numerical_gate: 7011-point law/adjoint verification, then selected probability, classification, Brier, input VJP and checkpoint step. To claim measured whole-fit acceleration require mean paired full cost improvement in both tasks plus identical labels, same selection step and max prediction discrepancy <=1e-4 across all three seed pairs per task. Report actual differences and failed costs. Shared host affects timing.
functional_gate: To establish curvature advantage over tangent controls, each task needs matched physical QVI (newton) to exceed both by >=.02 mean BA and Brier not higher. No test feedback or tuning.
